turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: Good evening. My name is Alex. I am your driver. Are you Ms Brown?

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: Yes, I am. Good evening. Thank you for waiting. It took a little longer to collect my luggage.

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: You are welcome. Your booking is for Central Hotel, is that right?

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: Yes, that is right. I have 2 bags. Could you help me with the largest one, please?

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: Of course. Your car is just outside. Please keep your passport and any medicine with you.

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: Thank you. I appreciate your help. I will keep my small bag with me.

translation: Alex accueille Mme Brown le soir, vérifie la réservation pour Central Hotel et propose de l’aide. La cliente a 2 bagages et demande de l’aide avec le plus grand. Les documents et médicaments restent avec elle.

turns.speaker: Driver

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: Hello, I have arrived at the station, but I cannot see your car.

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: Hello. Please go to exit 2, on the ground floor. I am waiting in the authorised pick-up area.

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: I can see a café and a blue information sign. Am I in the right place?

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: Yes. The pick-up area is opposite the café, next to the blue sign. Please use the pedestrian crossing.

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: Thank you. Should I go upstairs or stay on this level?

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: Please stay on the ground floor. I will be beside the car and I will check your name when you arrive.

translation: Le client doit rejoindre la sortie 2 au rez-de-chaussée. Le véhicule est dans la zone autorisée en face du café, près du panneau bleu. Il faut utiliser le passage piéton.

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: May I help you with your luggage?

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: Yes, please. We have 2 large suitcases and one small bag. The small bag contains medicine.

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: Please keep the medicine with you. Are there any fragile items in the suitcases?

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: Yes. One suitcase contains a fragile gift. Please do not put heavy bags on top of it.

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: Thank you for telling me. I will check that everything can be stored safely before we leave.

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: That is perfect. Please ask me before folding my walking aid. I can show you how it works.

translation: Le groupe possède 2 grandes valises et un petit sac contenant des médicaments. Un cadeau fragile doit être protégé. Le passager demande d’être consulté avant de plier son aide à la mobilité.

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: Welcome on board. Could you fasten your seat belt, please?

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: Of course. Could you make the car a little cooler? It is quite warm today.

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: Certainly. I will adjust the air conditioning when it is safe to do so. Would you prefer a quiet journey?

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: Yes, please. I need to rest. Please let me know when we are close to the hotel.

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: Of course. The journey should take about 25 minutes, depending on traffic.

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: Thank you. I will keep my seat belt fastened. Please stop in a safe place if you need to check anything.

translation: Le conducteur rappelle la ceinture, propose d’ajuster la climatisation et respecte le souhait d’un trajet calme. Le temps estimé est d’environ 25 minutes selon la circulation.

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: The usual route should take about 25 minutes, but there are roadworks today.

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: Is there another route? We would prefer to avoid arriving too late.

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: Yes. The toll road may save about ten minutes. The toll costs 5 euros and is not included in the original fare.

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: Thank you for explaining. We agree to use the toll road and pay the additional toll.

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: I will use the authorised route. If traffic changes, I will update you when it is safe to do so.

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: That is fine. Please do not take any risks to make up time.

translation: Des travaux affectent le trajet de 25 minutes. Le péage coûte 5 € en plus et pourrait faire gagner dix minutes. Le client accepte cette option et demande de préserver la sécurité.

turns.text: The agreed fare for this transfer is 60 euros. It includes the journey to Central Hotel.

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: Does that include waiting time and an extra stop?

turns.text: Does that include waiting time and an extra stop?

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: It includes ten minutes of waiting. An additional stop would cost 25 euros if we agree to it before changing the journey.

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: I understand. We would like one extra stop at the pharmacy, please.

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: Let me check the route and confirm the new total: 115 euros, with the extra stop included.

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: Yes, that is acceptable. Thank you for explaining the price before we leave.

translation: Le transfert initial coûte 90 € et inclut dix minutes d’attente. L’arrêt supplémentaire à la pharmacie coûte 25 € ; le nouveau total convenu est 115 €.

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: Hello, I am sorry, but I am running about 10 minutes late because of an unexpected road closure.

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: Thank you for letting me know. We are still at the hotel reception.

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: I expect to arrive in about 10 minutes. Would you like me to contact the office to check an alternative vehicle?

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: Please check with your office. Our appointment is important, and we would like the most reliable option.

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: I will contact the office from a safe place and update you with a confirmed solution.

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: Thank you. Please use the same pick-up point unless we agree on a change.

translation: Une fermeture imprévue crée environ 10 minutes de retard. Le client reste à la réception. Le chauffeur doit vérifier un véhicule alternatif avec le bureau et confirmer la solution.

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: The total fare is 60 euros. Would you like to pay by card or in cash?

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: By card, please. Could I also have a receipt and an invoice for my company?

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: Of course. Please wait while I check that the payment has been confirmed.

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: The terminal screen has changed. Should I try the card again?

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: Not yet. I will check the status first so that you are not charged twice. Then I will arrange the documents.

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: Thank you. I will give you the company details needed for the invoice through the agreed secure channel.

translation: Le passager paie 60 € par carte et demande un reçu ainsi qu’une facture pour son entreprise. Le conducteur vérifie la confirmation avant toute seconde tentative pour éviter un double débit.

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: Hello, I think I left my phone in your car after the transfer.

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: I am sorry to hear that. Could you confirm the booking name and the time of the journey?

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: The booking was under Brown. We arrived at Central Hotel this morning.

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: Thank you. I will check the vehicle when I am safely parked and contact the office to arrange the next step.

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: If you find it, could you leave it with a stranger outside the hotel?

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: For security reasons, I will arrange a verified handover through the office. I cannot promise a refund or delivery until the details are checked.

translation: Un téléphone aurait été oublié après le trajet de Brown vers Central Hotel. Le conducteur vérifiera à l’arrêt et organisera une remise vérifiée avec le bureau, sans promesse non confirmée.

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: Could you recommend something to visit near our hotel?

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: The old town and the harbour are popular places to explore. You can walk between them using the pedestrian route.

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: Is the small museum open this afternoon?

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: I am not sure about today’s opening hours. I can check an official source when we stop, rather than give you an uncertain time.

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: Thank you. Do we need to book a restaurant as well?

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.text: A booking may be useful, but availability changes. I can help you find the contact details once the car is safely parked.

translation: Le conducteur propose la vieille ville et le port. Il ne connaît pas les horaires du musée ni la disponibilité du restaurant et propose une vérification une fois stationné.
